query:
-- Impact Metrics table
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS impact_metrics (
  id INT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,
  year INT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
  genomes_sequenced_target INT DEFAULT 0,
  chemical_profiles_target INT DEFAULT 0,
  documents_digitized_target INT DEFAULT 0,
  citizen_contributors_target INT DEFAULT 0,
  partners_target INT DEFAULT 0,
  notes TEXT,
  created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NOT NULL,
  updated_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NOT NULL
);

-- Perfumum Plants table
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS perfumum_plants (
  id INT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,
  name VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,
  latin_name VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL UNIQUE,
  family VARCHAR(100),
  category VARCHAR(100),
  origin TEXT,
  habitat TEXT,
  olfactive_signature TEXT,
  dominant_molecules TEXT,
  climatic_axis VARCHAR(100),
  traditional_use TEXT,
  absorbe_use TEXT,
  kingdom VARCHAR(100) DEFAULT 'Plantae',
  division VARCHAR(100),
  class_field VARCHAR(100),
  order_name VARCHAR(100),
  genus VARCHAR(100),
  species VARCHAR(100),
  life_cycle VARCHAR(100),
  harvest_period VARCHAR(100),
  essential_oil_yield VARCHAR(100),
  notes TEXT,
  created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NOT NULL,
  updated_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NOT NULL,
  INDEX pp_family_idx (family),
  INDEX pp_axis_idx (climatic_axis)
);

-- Perfumum Molecules table
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS perfumum_molecules (
  id INT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,
  molecule_name VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL UNIQUE,
  family VARCHAR(100),
  odor_key TEXT,
  role ENUM('diffusion', 'modulation', 'structure', 'fixation'),
  climatic_axis VARCHAR(100),
  created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NOT NULL,
  updated_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NOT NULL,
  INDEX pmol_family_idx (family),
  INDEX pmol_role_idx (role)
);

-- Perfumum Plant Molecules relation table
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS perfumum_plant_molecules (
  id INT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,
  plant_id INT NOT NULL,
  molecule_id INT NOT NULL,
  percentage DECIMAL(5,2),
  notes TEXT,
  created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NOT NULL,
  INDEX ppm_plant_idx (plant_id),
  INDEX ppm_molecule_idx (molecule_id)
);
